head: codex/recovery-admission-20261012
title: fix: share recovery API budgets and repair original terminal debt
body:
## Scope

Reduce API amplification for autonomous recovery admission and add a recovery-only terminal transition for the exact original reservation whose terminal is missing. This PR remains Draft and grants no landing or deployment authority.

## Changes

- Admit only the three registered authorization workflows. Read the triggering run and exact attempt directly, and stop skipped observers before downstream work.
- Coordinate the three registered callers through one required DynamoDB compare-and-swap budget, with bounded GETs, concurrency, response/time limits, Retry-After/reset-aware 403/429 deferral, durable nonauthorizing checkpoints, and no blind retry after ambiguous writes.
- Preserve permission and API failures as nonapproval evidence.
- Add a signed-quorum CAS transition for the pinned PR #2655 reservation: RESERVED to CONSUMED, with lifecycle state ORIGINAL_RESERVATION_TERMINATED_RECOVERY_ONLY and authority scope ORIGINAL_TERMINAL_DEBT_ONLY. Revalidate the exact request, evidence, approvals, terminal, and immutable ACK when resuming. FINALIZER performs physical S3 readback; other roles report the signed ACK record without claiming physical verification.
- Connect the transition proof to the whole-platform collector. It records recovery debt reconciliation but does not count it as a normal landing terminal, platform closure, or authority. Normal terminal and independent natural CORE4 evidence remain required for overall closure.
- Bundle the writer and validate the exact bounded STAGING IAM/template change.

## Validation

Local checks passed: 39 Python ledger tests; 6 targeted Node test files for admission, rate-aware reads, shared-budget CAS/DynamoDB boundaries, and terminal repair/reconciliation; deterministic Lambda bundle validation. The whole-platform collector and staging deployer/boundary Node test files did not finish in this local run and are not counted as passing. Exact-head GitHub CI is pending.

## Remaining evidence and limits

- Shared-budget coverage is limited to the three registered admission workflows. Other workflows and direct GitHub API callers remain outside this budget.
- The quota owner is a repository-ID logical bucket; cross-runner behavior against a live protected workflow has not yet been demonstrated.
- No natural run has yet demonstrated the original scheduled reservation through the immutable repair receipt. The repair record reconciles reservation debt only; it does not replace the normal terminal or natural CORE4 proof.
- Source is unmerged and undeployed. The actual reservation and mission remain unresolved until natural cross-runner, scheduled-reservation, and immutable-terminal evidence is verified.

Production, Public, G5, provider activation, Ready, approval, dispatch, merge, and deployment remain HOLD/outside this Draft's authority.
